Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
1) Vamp A tries an action and is blocked; B plays sup. Malleable Visage and
enters combat. Can A take the same action, since is untapped?

2)Is Crimson Fury playable by a vampire trying to leave torpor?

Thanx

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 09 Aug 2001 15:55:25 GMT, "Cartman" <federi...@libero.it>
wrote:

>1) Vamp A tries an action and is blocked; B plays sup. Malleable Visage and
>enters combat. Can A take the same action, since is untapped?

Sure. Should follow all the same rulings as Mask of 1000 Faces.

>2)Is Crimson Fury playable by a vampire trying to leave torpor?

Nope. It's playable only as a reaction card or a combat card. A
vampire trying to leave torpor is the acting minion, and cannot play it
as a reaction card. And a vampire blocked while leaving torpor is not
in combat, so cannot play it as a combat card.

-- Derek

"You should rush your predator this turn."
"Why?"
"Because he's not me."
